cpu.limits: Native count/offset stage only. Compilation, inputs, count reset, synchronization before timing and parity verification are outside timing. Completion synchronization is included. Five alternating warm rounds with twenty samples per round. No memory or end-to-end sampling speed claim.

limits: This inherited arithmetic risk is relevant to the expanded chemistry paths but is not newly introduced by PR 503.
Small count tables reproduce capacity boundaries without allocating enormous conformer/coordinate arrays.
Checks preserve existing count buffers and host synchronization points. No memory reduction is claimed.
Count-stage CPU overhead at 4096 buildable types is about 6.4 microseconds (31 percent); CUDA timing is effectively unchanged. This is not an end-to-end sampling benchmark.
Explicit budget policy, Python and nucleotide arithmetic, total-task workspace and pair-energy capacity are separate work.
Test runs overlap and must not be summed as unique coverage. The initial baseline benchmark bridge include failure was fixed before any numeric comparison.
